title: Career roadmap · Financial Analyst
summary: Build strong foundations in accounting, corporate finance, financial modelling, Excel and data analysis, then progress from junior financial analysis into FP&A, investment analysis, corporate finance or risk.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 3-year B.Com beginning in 2026. Use the final year for financial-modelling projects, internships, company analysis and professional qualification preparation. If a 4-year honours pathway is available, use the additional year for advanced finance, valuation, analytics and industry experience.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Financial Analyst is directly aligned with the Banking, Accounting & Finance (BAF) pathway.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Become employable in financial analysis through accounting, Excel, financial modelling, valuation and business analysis.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in FP&A, equity research, corporate finance, investment analysis, credit or risk.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Financial Analyst, Finance Manager, Investment Analyst, FP&A Manager or specialist finance roles.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine finance expertise with analytics, automation, AI-assisted modelling, financial technology and strategic decision-making.

The long-term Financial Analyst should move beyond spreadsheet reporting toward financial strategy, scenario modelling, automation, AI-assisted research, data analytics, risk management and executive decision support. Strong communication becomes increasingly important as analysts progress from preparing numbers to explaining what those numbers mean for the business.
